info.title: SpireLoc
info.description: A localization pipeline tool for Slay the Spire 2 mod development.

commands.name: action
commands.description: Run or inspect reusable YAML or JSON actions.

options.name: --minionlib-components
options.description: Enable MinionLib component compatibility conversion. (default: false)

options.name: --minionlib-namespace-top
options.description: MinionLib component namespace; leave empty to use namespace-top. (default: "")

options.name: --reversed
options.description: Convert game localization back to source form. (default: false)

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show help for an operation or its subcommands.

commands.name: pipe
commands.description: Build and execute a localization operation pipeline.

options.name: --merge
options.description:
--model-id baselib <namespace-top> [--reversed] [--from <value>] [--to <value>]
--model-id prefix <prefix> <table>... [--reversed] [--from <value>] [--to <value>]
--model-id ritsulib <mod-id> [--reversed] [--from <value>] [--to <value>]
--model-id vanilla [--reversed] [--from <value>] [--to <value>]
--output flat-json <path> [--from <value>]
--output nested-json <path> [--from <value>]
--output toml <path> [--from <value>]
--output yaml <path> [--from <value>]
--partition language <condition>... [--from <value>] [--matched <value>] [--unmatched <value>]
--partition regex <condition>... [--from <value>] [--matched <value>] [--unmatched <value>]
--partition table <condition>... [--from <value>] [--matched <value>] [--unmatched <value>]
--reshape ritsulib-model-capability merge [--from <value>] [--to <value>]
--reshape ritsulib-model-capability split [<mod-id>] [--from <value>] [--to <value>]

options.name: --minionlib-components
options.description: Enable MinionLib component compatibility conversion. (default: false)

options.name: --minionlib-namespace-top
options.description: MinionLib component namespace; leave empty to use mod-id. (default: "")

options.name: --disable-model-capabilities
options.description: Disable RitsuLib ModelCapability table separation and merging. (default: false)

options.name: --reversed
options.description: Convert game localization back to source form. (default: false)
